title: [Feature request] add predefined profiles modifications
symptom: User does profile modifications several times a day, especially before lunch, increasing the percentage for 30 or 60 minutes. They want predefined profile modifications similar to temporary targets, but they are limited by a hard limit of 130%.
cause: The hard limit for profile percentage is set to 130.0 in the code, preventing the user from setting profiles above 130%.
fix: Change the hard limit constant MAX from 130.0 to the desired maximum limit in the file InputPercent.kt.
evidence_quote: You can change hard limite set to 130.0 to your max limit ;
